title: Minimal consciousness is the presence of a world

statements.text: Globality, presentationality and transparency together yield the most elementary form of consciousness conceivable, the presence of a world: a coherent global model of reality, within a window of presence, that the system cannot recognize as a model. Such a state would have no inner structure, no subjective time and no first-person perspective, a selfless snapshot consciousness.

sources.quote: yields the most elementary form of conscious experience conceivable: The presence of a world
We could call this "Selfless Snapshot Consciousness".
